# China Travel Assistant Skill v0.2.0 - 天枢 TravelOS

TianShu TravelOS is now an eight-Skill Agent Plugin with a deterministic OmniRoute engine.

## Highlights

- Auto defaults ordinary requests to Pro exploration while keeping a stable conventional baseline.
- Standard, Pro, and explicit Pro Max share all core capabilities; they differ only in search breadth, novelty, and tolerated complexity.
- Flight-train, train-flight, nearby-airport, corridor-hub, split-ticket, date-shift, and overnight hypotheses carry explicit evidence and risk disclosures.
- Visualize is preferred in supported Agent hosts, with exact self-contained HTML, SVG, and Markdown fallbacks from the same itinerary JSON.
- The README, Skill metadata, provider setup guide, and eight-Skill architecture visual now make the Agent Skill identity explicit.

## Safety

Image generation never writes authoritative itinerary facts. Unknown price, availability, baggage, or refund fields remain unknown. Real-name entry, order submission, payment, cancellation, refund, and changes require separate explicit confirmation.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/19Chris19/china-travel-assistant/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the complete change list.
